answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. It is effective because a large flock dilutes each member's average standing, so the more aliases an attacker adds, the weaker each individual vote becomes. Consider a dawn as the anchor of the cost.
